title: Calibration History Fee: Calibration Workmanship Warranty Billing Clause
content:
**Clause.** Under the Workmanship Warranties, a calibration history fee is added to the calibration diagnostic charge posted on a calibration fault found not covered under a Calibration Workmanship Warranty. The calibration history fee follows the calibration attempts recorded as failed on the customer's calibration orders under ADAS Sensor Calibrations: two or more failed attempts, the extended history fee of USD 40.00; exactly one failed attempt, the single-failure history fee of USD 20.00; no failed attempt, no calibration history fee.

## The clause by count

| Failed calibration attempts recorded on the customer's calibration orders | Calibration history fee |
|---|---|
| none | none |
| exactly one | USD 20.00 |
| two | USD 40.00 |
| three or more | USD 40.00 |

## Scope of the count

The count takes in every calibration attempt recorded as failed on any of the customer's calibration orders. Attempts recorded as passed are not counted.

## Hypothetical cases

- A customer's calibration orders show one attempt that failed and was then passed on a second attempt: one failed attempt, USD 20.00.
- Two calibration orders each show one failed attempt: two failed attempts, USD 40.00.
- No attempt on the customer's calibration orders is recorded as failed: no calibration history fee is added.
